title: Retire obsolete dedicated Cyclotron Prospectus hosting while retaining recoverable state
description: Given Ryan explicitly requests one central Prospectus deployment and authenticated central access is accepted, when the obsolete dedicated hosting is retired, then the old default URL redirects to prospectus.anth.us and the old prospectus.cyclotron.anth.us record is removed, while central and marketing remain healthy. Configuration, routing, identity and catalog rollback evidence is saved privately; old backend/userpool/secrets/data are retained. Permanent resource cleanup requires exact separate action-time approval.
